name: Catalog Search Indexer Memory Leak & GC Stalls
description: Unbounded cache in search indexer consumes 96.8% heap, triggering 3.2s GC pauses and P99 latency spike to 4,200ms

alert.summary: WARNING: catalog-search-indexer P99 latency exceeded SLA (4,200ms vs SLA 200ms); Node memory >95%
alert.details: Progressive memory degradation over 3 hours. Full GC pauses lasting 3.2s causing request timeouts.

recentCommits.author: search-eng <search@acme.corp>
recentCommits.message: perf: cache recent search queries in local LRU map

recentLogErrors: [WARN] 2026-10-31T16:01:22.012Z GC pause duration exceeded threshold: scavenge took 1850ms, mark-sweep took 3200ms
[WARN] 2026-10-31T16:02:40.890Z JavaScript heap out of memory approaching limit (3920 MB / 4096 MB)

expectedDiagnosis.rootCauseAnalysis: Unbounded memory accumulation in local query cache (src/cache/lru.ts introduced in commit 4a3b2c1). Cache lacks TTL expiration and eviction bounds under high unique search queries, triggering full garbage collection pauses of 3+ seconds.

remediationPlan.rationale: Perform rolling restart of search pods to immediately release bloated heaps, scale replicas from 6 to 12 to halve per-pod query pressure, and increase heap limit to 6GB while a permanent TTL patch is developed.

actions.description: Scale replicas to 12 to halve per-pod query load
Perform rolling restart to reclaim leaked memory across pods
Increase heap headroom to 6GB as safety buffer

safetyReview.riskMitigationNotes: Rolling restart maintains minimum available 75% pod threshold, preventing search traffic disruption. Node cluster has 64GB available RAM to absorb replica scale and 6GB heap allocation.
